intended_object: A natural isomorphism, used inside a proof, between two diagrams. One is the diagram of residue groups ℤ/n over the S-power index category. The other is the diagram of power quotients G/G^n of a procyclic profinite group G. It applies when S lies in the set of primes p where G has infinite exponent. This reading comes from the docstring and from how the file uses it.
explanation: The definition only specializes the general comparison `residuePowerQuotientNatIso`. It supplies the index hypothesis through the lemma `powerImage_index_eq_of_infiniteSupport`. Its docstring calls it a "comparison", and its only uses are in later proofs in the same file (lines 337, 353 and 358), where it helps identify the inverse limit of a procyclic group with a product of ℤ_p's. It is a supporting step in a proof, not a standard notion from the literature, so there is no textbook object to compare it with.
